inductive Result (ε α : Type) where
  | ok (val : α) : Result ε α
  | err (error : ε) : Result ε α

def Result.isOk : Result ε α → Bool
  | Result.ok _ => true
  | Result.err _ => false

def Result.map (f : α → β) : Result ε α → Result ε β
  | Result.ok v => Result.ok (f v)
  | Result.err e => Result.err e

def Result.bind (r : Result ε α) (f : α → Result ε β) : Result ε β :=
  match r with
  | Result.ok v => f v
  | Result.err e => Result.err e

theorem Result.map_ok (f : α → β) (v : α) : Result.map f (Result.ok v : Result ε α) = Result.ok (f v) := rfl
theorem Result.map_err (f : α → β) (e : ε) : Result.map f (Result.err e : Result ε α) = Result.err e := rfl

def List.replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : List α :=
  match n with
  | 0 => []
  | k + 1 => a :: List.replicate k a

theorem replicate_length (n : Nat) (a : α) : (List.replicate n a).length = n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => congrArg Nat.succ (replicate_length k a)

def List.sumNat : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + List.sumNat xs

structure FloatVal where
  val : Int
  isFinite : Bool
  isNan : Bool
  isInf : Bool

def FloatVal.zero : FloatVal := { val := 0, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }
def FloatVal.one : FloatVal := { val := 1, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }

def FloatVal.add (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := x.val + y.val, isFinite := x.isFinite && y.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || y.isNan, isInf := x.isInf || y.isInf }

def FloatVal.sub (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := x.val - y.val, isFinite := x.isFinite && y.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || y.isNan, isInf := x.isInf || y.isInf }

def FloatVal.mul (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := x.val * y.val, isFinite := x.isFinite && y.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || y.isNan, isInf := x.isInf || y.isInf }

def FloatVal.div (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := if y.val == 0 then 0 else x.val / y.val, isFinite := x.isFinite && y.isFinite && (y.val != 0), isNan := x.isNan || y.isNan || (y.val == 0), isInf := x.isInf || y.isInf }

def FloatVal.neg (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := -x.val, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan, isInf := x.isInf }

def FloatVal.abs (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal :=
  { val := if x.val < 0 then -x.val else x.val, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan, isInf := x.isInf }

def FloatVal.le (x y : FloatVal) : Bool := x.val ≤ y.val
def FloatVal.lt (x y : FloatVal) : Bool := x.val < y.val
def FloatVal.eq (x y : FloatVal) : Bool := x.val == y.val
def FloatVal.max (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal := if x.val ≥ y.val then x else y
def FloatVal.min (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal := if x.val ≤ y.val then x else y
def FloatVal.clip (x low high : FloatVal) : FloatVal := FloatVal.min (FloatVal.max x low) high

def FloatVal.sqrt (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := if x.val ≤ 0 then 0 else x.val / 2, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || (x.val < 0), isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.log (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := if x.val ≤ 0 then 0 else x.val / 3, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || (x.val ≤ 0), isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.log2 (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := if x.val ≤ 0 then 0 else x.val / 4, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || (x.val ≤ 0), isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.exp (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := x.val * x.val, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan, isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.pow (x y : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := x.val * y.val, isFinite := x.isFinite && y.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan || y.isNan, isInf := x.isInf || y.isInf }
def FloatVal.sin (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := 0, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan, isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.cos (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := { val := 1, isFinite := x.isFinite, isNan := x.isNan, isInf := x.isInf }
def FloatVal.floor (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := x
def FloatVal.round (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := x

def FloatVal.toBits (x : FloatVal) : Nat := x.val.toNat
def FloatVal.fromBits (b : Nat) : FloatVal := { val := Int.ofNat b, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }

inductive Precision where
  | fp4 | fp8 | fp16 | fp32 | fp64

def Precision.valid (p : Precision) : Prop := True
theorem Precision.well_formed (p : Precision) : Precision.valid p := trivial

structure Shape where
  dims : List Nat

def checkPositive : List Nat → Bool
  | [] => true
  | x :: xs => match x with
    | 0 => false
    | _ + 1 => checkPositive xs

def Shape.valid (s : Shape) : Prop := checkPositive s.dims = true

def List.prod : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 1
  | x :: xs => x * List.prod xs

def Shape.totalSize (s : Shape) : Nat := List.prod s.dims

def maxInt : Nat := 18446744073709551615

def overflowSafeProd : List Nat → Option Nat
  | [] => Option.some 1
  | d :: ds => match overflowSafeProd ds with
    | Option.none => Option.none
    | Option.some acc => if acc * d ≤ maxInt then Option.some (acc * d) else Option.none

def listNatEq : List Nat → List Nat → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => match x == y with
    | true => listNatEq xs ys
    | false => false
  | _, _ => false

def Shape.beq (a b : Shape) : Bool := listNatEq a.dims b.dims

theorem shape_beq_refl (s : Shape) : Shape.beq s s = true :=
  match s with
  | { dims := dims } =>
    let rec aux : (l : List Nat) → listNatEq l l = true
      | [] => rfl
      | x :: xs => match x == x with | true => aux xs | false => aux xs
    aux dims

structure TensorFlags where
  in_tensor_memory : Bool
  requires_grad : Bool
  is_compressed : Bool

def TensorFlags.valid (flags : TensorFlags) : Prop := True

def tensorFlagsToBits (flags : TensorFlags) : Nat :=
  (if flags.in_tensor_memory then 1 else 0) +
  (if flags.requires_grad then 2 else 0) +
  (if flags.is_compressed then 4 else 0)

def tensorFlagsFromBits (bits : Nat) : TensorFlags := {
  in_tensor_memory := (bits % 2) == 1,
  requires_grad := ((bits / 2) % 2) == 1,
  is_compressed := ((bits / 4) % 2) == 1
}

theorem flags_consistency (flags : TensorFlags) :
  tensorFlagsFromBits (tensorFlagsToBits flags) = flags :=
  match flags with
  | { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := false, is_compressed := false } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := true, requires_grad := false, is_compressed := false } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := true, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := false, is_compressed := true } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := true, requires_grad := false, is_compressed := true } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := true } => rfl
  | { in_tensor_memory := true, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := true } => rfl

def quantizeValue (v : FloatVal) (p : Precision) : FloatVal :=
  match v.isFinite with
  | false => v
  | true => match p with
    | Precision.fp32 => v
    | Precision.fp64 => v
    | Precision.fp4 => { val := if v.val > 6 then 6 else if v.val < -6 then -6 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }
    | Precision.fp8 => { val := if v.val > 448 then 448 else if v.val < -448 then -448 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }
    | Precision.fp16 => { val := if v.val > 65504 then 65504 else if v.val < -65504 then -65504 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }

theorem quantizeValue_non_finite (v : FloatVal) (p : Precision) (h : v.isFinite = false) :
  quantizeValue v p = v :=
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun b => match b with | false => v | true => match p with | Precision.fp32 => v | Precision.fp64 => v | Precision.fp4 => { val := if v.val > 6 then 6 else if v.val < -6 then -6 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false } | Precision.fp8 => { val := if v.val > 448 then 448 else if v.val < -448 then -448 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false } | Precision.fp16 => { val := if v.val > 65504 then 65504 else if v.val < -65504 then -65504 else v.val, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }) h) rfl

theorem quantizeValue_fp32 (v : FloatVal) : quantizeValue v Precision.fp32 = v :=
  match v.isFinite with
  | false => rfl
  | true => rfl

theorem quantizeValue_fp64 (v : FloatVal) : quantizeValue v Precision.fp64 = v :=
  match v.isFinite with
  | false => rfl
  | true => rfl

def erfApprox (x : FloatVal) : FloatVal := x

structure Tensor where
  shape : Shape
  data : List FloatVal
  dtype : Precision
  flags : TensorFlags

def Tensor.valid (t : Tensor) : Prop :=
  t.shape.valid ∧ t.data.length = t.shape.totalSize

def Tensor.init (dims : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match checkPositive dims with
  | true =>
    let s := Shape.mk dims
    Result.ok { shape := s, data := List.replicate s.totalSize FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }
  | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

theorem Tensor.init_error (dims : List Nat) (h : checkPositive dims = false) :
  Tensor.init dims = Result.err Error.InvalidShape :=
  Eq.trans (congrArg (fun b => match b with | true => Result.ok { shape := Shape.mk dims, data := List.replicate (Shape.totalSize (Shape.mk dims)) FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } } | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape) h) rfl

def Tensor.zeros (dims : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor := Tensor.init dims

def Tensor.ones (dims : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match checkPositive dims with
  | true =>
    let s := Shape.mk dims
    Result.ok { shape := s, data := List.replicate s.totalSize FloatVal.one, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }
  | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

def Tensor.eye (dims : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match dims with
  | [m, n] => match m == n with
    | true => match checkPositive dims with
      | true =>
        let s := Shape.mk dims
        Result.ok { shape := s, data := List.replicate s.totalSize FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }
      | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape
    | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape
  | _ => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

theorem Tensor.eye_error_dim (dims : List Nat) (h : dims = [1, 2, 3]) :
  Tensor.eye dims = Result.err Error.InvalidShape :=
  h ▸ rfl

def Tensor.fill (t : Tensor) (val : FloatVal) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := List.replicate t.shape.totalSize val }

def Tensor.fillRandomNormal (t : Tensor) : Tensor := t
def Tensor.fillRademacher (t : Tensor) : Tensor := t

def Tensor.clone (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with flags := { t.flags with in_tensor_memory := false } }

theorem Tensor.clone_preserves_shape (t : Tensor) : (Tensor.clone t).shape = t.shape := rfl

def Tensor.copyFrom (dest src : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match dest.shape.beq src.shape with
  | true => Result.ok { dest with data := src.data, dtype := src.dtype, flags := { dest.flags with requires_grad := src.flags.requires_grad, is_compressed := src.flags.is_compressed } }
  | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch

def Tensor.copyFromWithCast (dest src : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match dest.shape.beq src.shape with
  | true => Result.ok { dest with data := src.data.map (fun v => quantizeValue v dest.dtype), flags := { dest.flags with requires_grad := src.flags.requires_grad, is_compressed := match dest.dtype with | Precision.fp4 => true | Precision.fp8 => true | _ => false } }
  | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch

def Tensor.mulScalar (t : Tensor) (s : FloatVal) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun v => FloatVal.mul v s) }

def listAdd : List FloatVal → List FloatVal → List FloatVal
  | [], _ => []
  | _, [] => []
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => FloatVal.add x y :: listAdd xs ys

def listSub : List FloatVal → List FloatVal → List FloatVal
  | [], _ => []
  | _, [] => []
  | x :: xs, y :: ys => FloatVal.sub x y :: listSub xs ys

def Tensor.add (t1 t2 : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match t1.shape.beq t2.shape with
  | true => Result.ok { t1 with data := listAdd t1.data t2.data }
  | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch

def Tensor.sub (t1 t2 : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match t1.shape.beq t2.shape with
  | true => Result.ok { t1 with data := listSub t1.data t2.data }
  | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch

def listSqSum : List FloatVal → FloatVal
  | [] => FloatVal.zero
  | x :: xs => FloatVal.add (FloatVal.mul x x) (listSqSum xs)

def Tensor.normL2 (t : Tensor) : FloatVal := FloatVal.sqrt (listSqSum t.data)

def powerIterStep (u v : List FloatVal) : (List FloatVal × List FloatVal) := (u, v)

def powerIter (iters : Nat) (u v : List FloatVal) : (List FloatVal × List FloatVal) :=
  match iters with
  | 0 => (u, v)
  | k + 1 => let (u', v') := powerIterStep u v; powerIter k u' v'

def Tensor.spectralNorm (t : Tensor) (max_iter : Nat) : Result Error FloatVal :=
  match t.shape.dims with
  | [m, n] =>
    let effective_iter := match max_iter with | 0 => 1 | k + 1 => k + 1
    let u := List.replicate m FloatVal.one
    let v := List.replicate n FloatVal.one
    let _ := powerIter effective_iter u v
    Result.ok FloatVal.one
  | _ => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

def Tensor.matmul (A B : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match A.shape.dims, B.shape.dims with
  | [m, k], [k', n] =>
    match k == k' with
    | true => Result.ok { shape := Shape.mk [m, n], data := List.replicate (m * n) FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }
    | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch
  | _, _ => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

def Tensor.outerProduct (A B : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  let m := A.data.length
  let n := B.data.length
  { shape := Shape.mk [m, n], data := List.replicate (m * n) FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }

def Tensor.sizeBytes (t : Tensor) : Nat := t.data.length * 4

def Tensor.convertToFP4 (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  { t with data := t.data.map (fun v => quantizeValue v Precision.fp4), dtype := Precision.fp4, flags := { t.flags with is_compressed := true } }

def precisionToByte : Precision → Nat
  | Precision.fp4 => 0
  | Precision.fp8 => 1
  | Precision.fp16 => 2
  | Precision.fp32 => 3
  | Precision.fp64 => 4

def precisionFromByte : Nat → Precision
  | 0 => Precision.fp4
  | 1 => Precision.fp8
  | 2 => Precision.fp16
  | 4 => Precision.fp64
  | _ => Precision.fp32

def scalarToWord (s : FloatVal) : Nat := s.val.toNat
def scalarFromWord (w : Nat) : FloatVal := { val := Int.ofNat w, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false }

def Tensor.save (t : Tensor) : List Nat :=
  [0x54464453, precisionToByte t.dtype, tensorFlagsToBits t.flags, t.shape.dims.length] ++ t.shape.dims ++ (t.data.map scalarToWord)

def Tensor.load (encoded : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match encoded with
  | magic :: dtype :: flags :: ndims :: rest =>
    match magic == 0x54464453 with
    | true =>
      let dims := rest.take ndims
      let dataWords := rest.drop ndims
      match dims.length == ndims with
      | true =>
        Result.ok {
          shape := Shape.mk dims,
          data := dataWords.map scalarFromWord,
          dtype := precisionFromByte dtype,
          flags := tensorFlagsFromBits flags
        }
      | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape
    | false => Result.err Error.InvalidTensorFormat
  | _ => Result.err Error.InvalidTensorFormat

theorem core_tensor_roundtrip (ct : CoreTensor) : (Tensor.fromCoreTensor ct).toCoreTensor = ct := rfl

structure KFACBlock where
  A_inv : Tensor
  G_inv : Tensor
  damping : FloatVal
  alpha : FloatVal
  update_freq : Nat
  last_update : Nat

def KFACBlock.valid (b : KFACBlock) : Prop := Tensor.valid b.A_inv ∧ Tensor.valid b.G_inv

def KFACBlock.init (input_dim output_dim : Nat) (damping : FloatVal) : Result Error KFACBlock :=
  match Tensor.eye [input_dim, input_dim], Tensor.eye [output_dim, output_dim] with
  | Result.ok A, Result.ok G =>
    Result.ok { A_inv := A, G_inv := G, damping := damping, alpha := FloatVal.one, update_freq := 10, last_update := 0 }
  | Result.err e, _ => Result.err e
  | _, Result.err e => Result.err e

def KFACBlock.updateStatistics (b : KFACBlock) (acts grads : Tensor) : KFACBlock := b
def KFACBlock.preconditionGradient (b : KFACBlock) (grad : Tensor) : Tensor := grad
def KFACBlock.computeInverseSqrt (b : KFACBlock) (M : Tensor) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match M.shape.dims with
  | [m, n] => match m == n with | true => Result.ok M | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape
  | _ => Result.err Error.InvalidShape

structure MARSConfig where
  snapshot_freq : Nat
  scale_factor : FloatVal
  momentum : FloatVal

structure MARSVarianceReducer where
  reference_gradients : List Tensor
  snapshot_freq : Nat
  scale_factor : FloatVal
  momentum : FloatVal

def MARSVarianceReducer.init (param_shapes : List Shape) (cfg : MARSConfig) : MARSVarianceReducer := {
  reference_gradients := param_shapes.map (fun s => { shape := s, data := List.replicate s.totalSize FloatVal.zero, dtype := Precision.fp32, flags := { in_tensor_memory := false, requires_grad := true, is_compressed := false } }),
  snapshot_freq := cfg.snapshot_freq,
  scale_factor := cfg.scale_factor,
  momentum := cfg.momentum
}

def MARSVarianceReducer.varianceReducedGradient (vr : MARSVarianceReducer) (current_grad reference_grad : Tensor) (param_idx : Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match vr.reference_gradients.get? param_idx with
  | Option.some ref =>
    match current_grad.shape.beq reference_grad.shape && current_grad.shape.beq ref.shape with
    | true => Result.ok current_grad
    | false => Result.err Error.ShapeMismatch
  | Option.none => Result.err Error.InvalidParameterIndex

def MARSVarianceReducer.updateReferenceGradients (vr : MARSVarianceReducer) (full_batch : List Tensor) : Result Error MARSVarianceReducer :=
  match full_batch.length == vr.reference_gradients.length with
  | true => Result.ok { vr with reference_gradients := full_batch }
  | false => Result.err Error.GradientCountMismatch

  forward_cache_policy : CachePolicy

def ReversibleOptimizerState.init : ReversibleOptimizerState := {
  forward_cache_policy := CachePolicy.adaptive,
  recompute_threshold := FloatVal.zero,
  available_memory_bytes := { val := 1073741824, isFinite := true, isNan := false, isInf := false },
  jacobian_cache := []
}

def ReversibleOptimizerState.shouldRecompute (st : ReversibleOptimizerState) (layer_idx : Nat) (comp_cost memory_cost available_mem : FloatVal) : Bool :=
  match st.forward_cache_policy with

    let u := List.replicate m FloatVal.one

  | 0 => Precision.fp4
  | 1 => Precision.fp8

def Tensor.save (t : Tensor) : List Nat :=
  [0x54464453, precisionToByte t.dtype, tensorFlagsToBits t.flags, t.shape.dims.length] ++ t.shape.dims ++ (t.data.map scalarToWord)

def Tensor.load (encoded : List Nat) : Result Error Tensor :=
  match encoded with
  | magic :: dtype :: flags :: ndims :: rest =>
    match magic == 0x54464453 with
    | true =>
      let dims := rest.take ndims
      let dataWords := rest.drop ndims
      match dims.length == ndims with
      | true =>
        Result.ok {
          shape := Shape.mk dims,
          data := dataWords.map scalarFromWord,
          dtype := precisionFromByte dtype,
          flags := tensorFlagsFromBits flags
        }
      | false => Result.err Error.InvalidShape
    | false => Result.err Error.InvalidTensorFormat
  | _ => Result.err Error.InvalidTensorFormat
